solutions.title: Iterative inorder early stop
solutions.strategy: Walk the BST in ascending order with a stack and return when the kth node is popped.

timeComplexity.explanation: The traversal descends at most h nodes before visiting the first value, then stops after k pops.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit stack stores the current search path.

solutions.title: Recursive inorder counter
solutions.strategy: Use inorder recursion while carrying a remaining-count field and short-circuit after the answer is found.

timeComplexity.explanation: Only nodes needed to reach the kth value are visited, plus the initial descent.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack follows tree height h.
